events.body:
## Context

In `frontend/src/pages/Triage.jsx` the refresh buttons have only `title`, the filter buttons don't expose `aria-pressed`, and the "Unable to connect to backend API" banner has no `role="status"`. The Sidebar mobile toggle has no `aria-expanded`/`aria-controls`.

## What to do

1. Add `aria-label`s to the refresh buttons and `aria-pressed={filter === f}` to the filters.
2. Add `role="status"` to the fallback banners in Triage.jsx and Overview.jsx.
3. Add `aria-expanded`/`aria-controls` to the Sidebar toggle.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] No "button has no accessible name" on /triage in Lighthouse
- [ ] Filter state is announced
- [ ] API-down banner is announced

## How to test locally

```bash
cd blt-toasty/frontend && npm ci && npm run dev
```
